sourceDetail.fidelity: Every p and i base64 value equals its supplied V3 source field byte for byte; restP takes precedence if supplied.
sourceDetail.lazyLoading: Fetch the detail descriptor for a nearby mesh. Decode p as little-endian Float32 triples and i as little-endian Uint32 triangle indices. Positions already use the same display millimetre frame as the overview. Replace the matching id geometry, keeping its material/visibility state.

sources.terms: BodyParts3D CC BY-SA 2.1 Japan, preserved from the supplied v3 mirror

method.name: Overview spatial vertex clustering plus exact V3 surface detail
method.retained: All 86 provided source surfaces: skin, cortical gyri, thalami, pons, medulla, cerebellum, 41 skeletal meshes, and four forearm muscle meshes
method.excluded: None of the supplied anatomical source meshes
method.limitations: Overview surfaces use spatial clustering; every supplied V3 surface is also retained at its exact original supplied resolution as a locally loadable detail asset. These are source-derived atlas surfaces, not patient-specific, histology-registered, or watertight simulation geometry. The imported skin retains the earlier upper-body crop. No new cross sections or clipping windows are introduced.
